name: Kenji
label: Free tier ad-tolerant listener
who: I mostly use Spotify on the free tier and I'm fine with ads as long as I can listen to the music I like. I've had Premium before and I'm tempted to pay again because I want to choose songs and skip without ads.
value_for_money: Mixed. Says the free tier is fine if the ads are tolerable, but calls Premium worth it for song choice and no ads, while another says they won't pay to remove ads they still hear on the free tier.
loyalty: Keeps coming back to the service and has returned to paid features after cancelling. Would stay on the free tier if ads are tolerable, but frustration with ad frequency and random shuffle has pushed them to cancel before.
pain_points: Ad frequency on the free tier
Only random songs on the free version
Can't skip many songs on free
tone: Casual and expressive, often venting about ads or shuffle and then explaining what they want.
